name: Religion persistence: Q79 both facts, paid revival, all eight applied choices, exact save/load, actual yields and placeholder hero

steps.code: if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local n=0; for row in GameInfo.JAC_RP_Religions() do n=n+1; for _,tag in ipairs({row.Name,'LOC_JAC_RP_PUBLIC','LOC_JAC_RP_UNDERGROUND','LOC_JAC_RP_LOST','LOC_JAC_RP_SCRIPTURE','LOC_JAC_RP_REVIVE','LOC_JAC_RP_APPLIED','LOC_JAC_RP_PENDING'}) do local t=Locale.Lookup(tag); if t==tag or t=='' then error('missing localized text '..tag) end end end; if n~=20 then error('placeholder count '..n) end; return '20 placeholders and state text localized'

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p~=nil and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: if Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=0 then error('wrong local founder') end; local p=Players[0]; local settler=nil; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units.UNIT_SETTLER.Index then settler=u; break end end; if not settler then error('missing founding settler') end; UnitManager.RequestOperation(settler,UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY); return 'capital requested'

local p=Players[0]; for r in GameInfo.Technologies() do if r.Cost<=60 then p:GetTechs():SetTech(r.Index,true) end end; for r in GameInfo.Civics() do if r.Cost<=100 then p:GetCulture():SetCivic(r.Index,true) end end; p:GetDiplomacy():SetHasMet(1); if p:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(1) then p:GetDiplomacy():MakePeaceWith(1,true) end; return 'branch prerequisites prepared'

local p=Players[0]; local tech,civic; for r in GameInfo.Technologies() do if p:GetTechs():CanResearch(r.Index) and p:GetTechs():GetResearchCost(r.Index)-p:GetTechs():GetResearchProgress(r.Index)>20 then tech=r; break end end; for r in GameInfo.Civics() do if p:GetCulture():CanProgress(r.Index) and p:GetCulture():GetCultureCost(r.Index)-p:GetCulture():GetCulturalProgress(r.Index)>50 then civic=r; break end end; if not tech or not civic then error('no unfinished research large enough for yield checks') end; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.RESEARCH,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_TECH_TYPE]=tech.Hash,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.PROGRESS_CIVIC,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CIVIC_TYPE]=civic.Hash,[PlayerOperations.PARAM_INSERT_MODE]=PlayerOperations.VALUE_EXCLUSIVE}); ExposedMembers.JAC_RP_TestTargets={tech=tech.Index,civic=civic.Index}; return 'research selected'

condition.code: local p=Players[0]; local t=ExposedMembers.JAC_RP_TestTargets; return t~=nil and p:GetTechs():GetResearchingTech()==t.tech and p:GetCulture():GetProgressingCivic()==t.civic

steps.code: local p=Players[0]; local t=p:GetTechs():GetResearchingTech(); local c=p:GetCulture():GetProgressingCivic(); if t<0 or c<0 then error('research not selected') end; return tostring(t)..'|'..tostring(p:GetTechs():GetResearchProgress(t))..'|'..tostring(c)..'|'..tostring(p:GetCulture():GetCulturalProgress(c))

local p=Players[0]; local n=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units.UNIT_SCOUT.Index then n=n+1 end end; return tostring(p:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance())..'|'..tostring(p:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance())..'|'..tostring(p:GetDiplomacy():GetFavor())..'|'..tostring(n)

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_ReligionPersistence; local id='JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_03'; R.Found(id,1,'origin',1,0,'PLAYER_1'); R.SetCommunity(id,'origin',0,0,'PLAYER_1'); R.SetCommunity('JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_02','adopter',1,0,'PLAYER_0'); local city=Players[0]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity():GetID(); for _,o in ipairs({'SELL','CONCEAL','RESEARCH','HERESY','ABSORB','ARTIFACT','DIPLOMATIC_INCIDENT','HERO'}) do R.Discover(id,'choice_'..o,'material_'..o,'SCRIPTURE','ACTOR_'..o,'TRAVELER','CAVE',0); R.ResolveDiscovery(id,'choice_'..o,o,{city=city,targetReligion='JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_02',targetPlayer=1}) end; local ai='JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_04'; R.Found(ai,0,'origin',1,0,'PLAYER_0'); R.SetCommunity(ai,'origin',0,0,'PLAYER_0'); R.Discover(ai,'ai_sale','ai_book','RELIC','THIEF_1','THIEF','RUINS',1); local gold=Players[1]:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance(); if R.ResolveForAI(ai,'ai_sale',{})~='SELL' or Players[1]:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()~=gold+40 then error('AI sale failed') end; local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_ReligionPersistence; local id='JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_03'; local s=R.Inspect(id); local choices={'SELL','CONCEAL','RESEARCH','HERESY','ABSORB','ARTIFACT','DIPLOMATIC_INCIDENT','HERO'}; if s.followers~=0 or s.state~='LOST' or not s.underground or not s.canRevive then error('both continuity facts or concealed source lost') end; for _,o in ipairs(choices) do local d=s.discoveries['choice_'..o]; if not d or d.outcome~=o or d.effects~='APPLIED' then error('missing applied choice '..o) end; local before=R.Snapshot(); if pcall(R.ResolveDiscovery,id,'choice_'..o,o,{city=Players[0]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity():GetID(),targetReligion='JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_02',targetPlayer=1}) then error('replay accepted '..o) end; if R.Snapshot()~=before then error('replay mutated ledger') end end; if s.assets.material_CONCEAL.holder~='HIDDEN_PLAYER_0' or not s.assets.material_ARTIFACT.vault or s.assets.material_HERESY.interpretation~='HERETICAL' then error('material disposition') end; if s.assets.material_ABSORB~=nil or R.Inspect('JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_02').assets.material_ABSORB.originReligion~=id then error('absorption did not transfer item') end; if s.assets.material_DIPLOMATIC_INCIDENT.owner~=1 then error('material not returned to founder') end; local hero=R.Export().heroes['0']; if not hero or hero.unit==nil then error('hero receipt missing') end; local u=Players[0]:GetUnits():FindID(hero.unit); if not u or u:GetType()~=GameInfo.Units.UNIT_SCOUT.Index then error('hero Unit missing') end; if R.Inspect('JAC_RP_PLACEHOLDER_04').discoveries.ai_sale.effects~='APPLIED' then error('AI choice lost') end; return R.Snapshot()
